page: Microsoft Azure M32bs_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the MBSMediumMemoryv3 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8473C processor operating at 4.0 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a 105 MB L3 cache. The system is configured with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. There is no local storage or GPU bundled with this instance, though it is premium storage capable and designed for block storage performance.

Benchmark data shows strong performance in specific workloads. The instance achieves strong results in single-threaded gzip compression (33.05 GB/sec), multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (210.74 GB/sec), and Geekbench image and text processing. Static web serving throughput is also strong at 53.69 GB/sec. For language model inference, the server achieves top-tier performance on small models (135M) with 343.5 tokens/sec for text generation, but exhibits a clear performance tradeoff on large models (70B), dropping to a weak 2.74 tokens/sec. General CPU and memory benchmarks, such as Passmark and stress-ng, fall within the average range.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the M32bs_v3 offers a dense memory profile relative to its compute resources, making it suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. Given its high memory capacity and strong text and image processing capabilities, this server is well-suited for medium-scale database operations, caching layers, enterprise web serving, and software compilation.
